name: Ishikawa

flag.description: A white emblem on a blue field: the kanji 石川 (Ishikawa) drawn in the shape of the Noto Peninsula.
flag.symbolism: The blue stands for the Sea of Japan and for the prefecture's greenery, clean water and clear air.

hook: Ishikawa's white strokes on blue spell 石川 (Ishikawa) and trace the Noto Peninsula jutting into the sea.
trivia: Kanazawa, the capital, makes almost all of Japan's gold leaf.
Ishikawa is the only prefecture with no separate emblem: the design on its flag serves instead.
